units.source_text: 杜子春一个人坐在岩石，寂静的望着遥远的星宸。

en.t: Du Zichun sat alone on a rock, silently gazing at the distant stars.

units.source_text: 大约过了半个时辰的样子，深夜的凉气开始穿透人的衣裳，令人瑟瑟发抖，恰在此时，空中传来训斥声：

en.t: After about half an hour had passed, the chill of the deep night began to pierce through his clothes, making him shiver; just then, a scolding voice came from the sky:
